messages:
sofia-peopleops: Flagging an urgent payroll issue 1: Emily's April payroll shows both US federal/state withholding and Irish PAYE. She submitted relocation docs effective 2026-04-01 but payroll cut happened same day. Can payroll confirm what applied?

ben-payroll: Saw this in the closed payrun (run id PR-20260401-99). Vendor log indicates residence change arrived 04/01 at 15:03 UTC, after our vendor's cutoff for that run. System applied the US tax engine and then ran IE PAYE conversion, resulting in both withholdings.

payroll-bot: Notice: PR-20260401-99 closed — employee EM-7724 stub generated stub_EM-7724_2026-04-01.pdf.

emily: Hi all 1: Net was 2,100 less than expected. This wipes out most of my April take-home. Appreciate quick resolution.

team-lead-ops: Sorry Emily. Can finance hold any team-level bonus distribution pending fix?

ben-payroll: Proposed remediation: 1) Off-cycle retro to refund the US withholdings and employer tax pickup; 2) Update vendor to treat 2026-04-01 as effective residence so future runs use IE only; 3) Prepare W-2c if US taxes were reported and coordinate with Irish payroll for P60/P45 notes.

acct-fw: @ben-payroll we need GL mapping for the retro. Also estimate employer tax recovery so we can reserve accruals for month-end close.

ben-payroll: Estimated numbers: refund US federal + state = 1,340.00 USD; employer SS/Med = 280.00 USD. I'll attach calculations to vendor ticket and create a journal entry request.

sofia-peopleops: Emily, we'll expedite an off-cycle payment and confirm once posted. Do you have your Irish PPSN and local bank details on file? Payroll will DM any missing items.

emily: PPSN and IBAN are in my relocation packet, yes. DM me if you need anything else.

ben-payroll: I've opened ticket VEND-6022 and requested expedited retro. Vendor ETA 36-48 hrs. Will mark ticket with urgency and ask for audit trail showing both withholdings.

payroll-bot: Ticket VEND-6022 created, priority: high.

sofia-peopleops: Please add a short audit blurb to Emily's employee record noting mid-pay-period residency change and the corrective steps we've taken. We'll need that for internal audit and external tax inquiries.

ben-payroll: Will update employee notes and cc finance. If vendor reports taxes already deposited, we may need to prepare W-2c and liaise with Irish tax counsel on credit/offset.

team-lead-ops: Thanks. Once off-cycle posts, can someone confirm release of the team bonus hold?

ben-payroll: Yes, I'll confirm here when off-cycle completed and ledger entries are posted.

emily: Really appreciate the quick action.

sofia-peopleops: Keeping thread open until off-cycle shows on bank. Pinning. :pushpin:
